records.scope: Entire javap display including diagnostic main; not executed.
records.observation: Requires exactly one filename argument, otherwise diagnostic and System.exit0. Creates category list, topology->shadow HashMap and YCoordMap list; records wall-clock Date before/after InputLog constructor and after loop+close. Loop uses static Kind reference equality, one peek per iteration, handles TOPOLOGY/YCOORDMAP/CATEGORY/PRIMITIVE with separate ifs. Topology creates shadow category added BOTH to category list and shadow map; regular category list therefore printed under Primitive Category Definitions also includes shadows. Shared category references retained, so later updates are reflected when printed after EOF. Primitive printed immediately with preincremented long count, no explicit resolveCategory or chronological check; metadata may differ from later category state. No COMPOSITE branch or unknown-kind diagnostic here; known CLOG2 decoder emits no composites, unknown simply loops. EOF closes then prints shadow map in HashMap iteration order, category list, coordinate maps, primitive count, delegated unmatched count and total bytes, and two wall-clock durations. No try/finally, catch, file write or SLOG2 output. Total ByteSize of logfile label actually uses ContentIterator counter (excludes preamble/block padding, counts claimed read/skip sizes), not filesystem size. Unmatched statistics retain previously documented category-list duplication/omission behavior; printing is no independent integrity gate. No archived execution or validation approval.
